records.source: ...Do you still love me?$s
records.translation: ……你還愛我嗎？$s

records.source: *sigh*... Maybe we got married too young.$s
records.translation: *嘆氣*……也許我們太年輕就結婚了。$s

records.source: Are you still happy with me?$s
records.translation: 和我在一起還幸福嗎？$s

records.source: Did I do something wrong? You've been acting different lately.$s
records.translation: 我做錯了什麼嗎？你最近表現得不太一樣。$s

records.source: Do you ever wonder what else is out there?$s
records.translation: 有沒有想過外面的世界還有些什麼？$s

records.source: You used to be romantic... what happened?$s#$e#I know I'm not as young as I used to be... is that what you married me for?$a
records.translation: 你以前很浪漫……現在怎麼了？$s#$e#我知道自己不再像以前那麼年輕……你當初是為了年輕才和我結婚嗎？$a

records.source: We only have one short life to live... is this the best way to do it?$s
records.translation: 我們短暫的一生只有一次……這真的是最好的活法嗎？$s

records.source: I used to be your sweetie... now you only seem to put up with me when I make a hot dinner.$s
records.translation: 我以前是你的甜心……現在似乎只有煮好熱騰騰的晚餐時，你才願意忍受我。$s

records.source: You've been so cold to me lately...$s
records.translation: 你最近對我非常冷淡……$s

records.source: I wonder if I could've done better.$s
records.translation: 不知道自己是不是能有更好的選擇。$s

records.source: Well, a new year has arrived. Do you have a plan for what you want to accomplish this year?#$e#I feel pretty hopeful.
records.translation: 好啦，新的一年到來了。有沒有計畫今年想完成什麼？#$e#我對未來充滿希望。

records.source: Now that winter's over, we've got lots of productive weather to look forward to.
records.translation: 既然冬季結束了，接下來有許多適合生產的好天氣值得期待。

records.source: I hope you've been practicing your moves... tomorrow is the flower dance!
records.translation: 希望你一直有練習舞步……明天就是花舞節！

records.source: Make sure you don't get a heat stroke, dear.#$e#Drink plenty of water and don't overwork yourself.
records.translation: 親愛的，小心別中暑了。#$e#多喝水，別工作過度。

records.source: Sorry if I smell... I was sweating all night in the heat.
records.translation: 如果身上有味道，先說聲抱歉……昨晚熱得一直流汗。

records.source: It's summer... that means the house is full of flies.#$e#Don't worry, I'll take care of them.
records.translation: 夏天到了……這表示屋裡到處都是蒼蠅。#$e#別擔心，我會處理牠們。

records.source: This weather feels pretty nice after the heat of summer.
records.translation: 熬過炎熱的夏季後，這種天氣感覺相當舒服。

records.source: Winter's just around the corner. We need to double check the heating system, turn off the valves, and check all the insulation in the house.#$e#Don't worry, I'll take care of it all.
records.translation: 冬季就快到了。我們得再次檢查暖氣系統、關閉閥門，並確認屋裡所有隔熱設備。#$e#別擔心，全部交給我處理。

records.source: Have you figured out what you're going to use for our grange display tomorrow?
records.translation: 想好明天的農產品展要用哪些物品了嗎？

records.source: Should we go to the Spirit's Eve festival tomorrow night?
records.translation: 明晚要一起去參加萬靈節嗎？

records.source: Brrr.... It's cold. I guess winter has arrived.
records.translation: 噗嚕嚕……好冷。看來冬季到了。

records.source: Are you going to enter the fishing contest tomorrow?
records.translation: 明天要參加釣魚比賽嗎？

records.source: Thanks for a great year, @. I'm excited to tackle next year together.$l
records.translation: @，謝謝你帶來如此美好的一年。我很期待一起迎接明年。$l

records.source: I'm feeling excited for a new year of farming, @!$h
records.translation: @，想到新一年的農場生活，我就好興奮！$h

records.source: I may like the colder seasons, but by the end I'm always glad to see spring arrive.
records.translation: 我也許喜歡比較寒冷的季節，不過每到季末，總會很高興看到春天來臨。

records.source: Aren't you glad winter's over, honey? Things seem more hopeful now.
records.translation: 親愛的，冬季結束了，不開心嗎？現在一切似乎都更有希望。

records.source: Don't forget to look for wild horseradish, leeks and dandelions while you're out there!
records.translation: 在外面時，別忘了找找野山葵、韭蔥和蒲公英！

records.source: I'm so happy to see some greenery after that long white winter.
records.translation: 經過漫長的白色冬季，看到一些綠意真讓人開心。

records.source: Wow, my skin is pale... I guess I'd better help you with some farm work this season.
records.translation: 哇，我的皮膚真蒼白……看來這個季節最好幫忙做些農務。

records.source: Let's plant some healthy vegetables this spring.$h
records.translation: 今年春天一起種些健康的蔬菜吧。$h

records.source: I'm looking forward to a beautiful year on %farm farm.$h
records.translation: 我很期待在%farm農場度過美好的一年。$h

records.source: Hey @. Let's work hard today!
records.translation: 嘿，@。今天一起努力工作吧！

records.source: *sniff* ... My doze is stubbed up... allergies.
records.translation: *吸鼻子*……我的鼻紙堵住了……過敏。

records.source: Maybe I'll learn a new skill this year...
records.translation: 今年也許可以學一項新技能……

records.source: It's a good time of year to do some stargazing.
records.translation: 每年這個時候很適合觀星。

records.source: Oh man... I could go for some chocolate cake.
records.translation: 喔，天啊……真想吃點巧克力蛋糕。

records.source: You must know by now that summer is my favorite season.$h
records.translation: 現在一定知道夏天是我最喜歡的季節了。$h

records.source: Nothing pairs so well with summer like a nice sweet wine. Don't you think, honey?
records.translation: 沒有什麼比一杯美味甜酒更適合搭配夏天。親愛的，不覺得嗎？

records.source: Are you growing any melons this summer?
records.translation: 今年夏天有種甜瓜嗎？

records.source: I'm going to stay inside as much as possible this summer.
records.translation: 今年夏天我要儘量待在室內。

records.source: Make sure you don't get sunburnt, honey... That can really damage your skin.
records.translation: 親愛的，一定要小心別曬傷……那真的會傷害皮膚。

records.source: One of the main things I miss about the ocean is the fresh fish.
records.translation: 離開海邊後，最懷念的事物之一就是新鮮魚肉。

records.source: I always have the most energy in the summer.
records.translation: 每到夏季，我總是最有活力。

records.source: Summer always makes me want to eat more barbecue.
records.translation: 夏天總是讓我更想多吃些燒烤。

records.source: Phew! It's hot but it feels great, doesn't it?#$e#Maybe we'll see some wild parrots today.
records.translation: 呼！天氣很熱，但感覺真棒，對吧？#$e#今天也許會看到一些野生鸚鵡。

records.source: What's on my agenda today... hmmm... #$e#I think I see some spicy pretzel snacks and a couple of 'cold boys' on the horizon.
records.translation: 今天有什麼計畫……嗯……#$e#我彷彿看見遠方出現了一些辣味蝴蝶餅，還有幾罐「冰涼小子」。

records.source: I'm glad I still work at the clinic... It's an important service for the community.
records.translation: 很高興自己還在診所工作……那是為社區提供的重要服務。

records.source: I hope we're growing pumpkins this year.$h
records.translation: 希望我們今年有種南瓜。$h

records.source: I'm craving cake.#$e#But not just any cake... it has to be pink.
records.translation: 我好想吃蛋糕。#$e#不過不是隨便哪種蛋糕……一定要粉紅色。

records.source: Breathe deep... can you smell that? That tells me it's mushroom season.
records.translation: 深吸一口氣……聞到了嗎？那股氣味告訴我，蘑菇的季節到了。

records.source: It's so peaceful out here on the farm. I never appreciated nature that much living in town.
records.translation: 農場這裡實在太寧靜了。住在鎮上時，我從未如此欣賞大自然。

records.source: My mother used to always make this delicious pumpkin soup in the fall.
records.translation: 我媽媽以前總會在秋季煮美味的南瓜湯。

records.source: I could sure go for some wine.
records.translation: 現在真想喝點葡萄酒。

records.source: Ah... Fall. The warm sun drifts low in the sky, casting long shadows over waving fields of gold.#$e#It's a beautiful time of year, don't you think?
records.translation: 啊……秋天。溫暖的太陽低垂於天際，在搖曳的金色田野上投下長長影子。#$e#這是一年中最美麗的時節，不覺得嗎？

records.source: I feel weak... I need some protein.$s
records.translation: 感覺好虛弱……我需要一些蛋白質。$s

records.source: I wonder what's going on in the rest of the world? We're really secluded here.
records.translation: 不知道世界其他地方正在發生什麼事？我們住的地方真的很與世隔絕。

records.source: I drank a super-food smoothie this morning and I feel aaah-mazing!$h
records.translation: 今天早上喝了一杯超級食物果昔，感覺太～棒～了！$h

records.source: I think there might be a new species of fungus growing behind my mini-fridge.#$e#Ah well, 'tis the season, right?
records.translation: 我的迷你冰箱後面好像長出了一種全新的真菌。#$e#唉，反正正是這個季節，對吧？

records.source: Spring is coming soon. I'm really looking forward to having rhubarb pie.
records.translation: 春天很快就要來了。我真的很期待吃大黃派。

records.source: Remember when we played that 'Prairie King' game together, in my room? Those were good times.$h
records.translation: 還記得我們在我的房間一起玩「草原王」遊戲嗎？那段時光真美好。$h
